trees.description: Shop-like operations for the racing team: workflow, staffing, and race prep tools.

nodes.title: Laptop
nodes.description: Access the computer from the vehicle bay
nodes.detailedDescription:
Install a laptop in the garage so you can run the Racing Computer without walking up to the office.

**Effect**
- Adds a second Racing Computer access point down in the vehicle bay.
- The bay walking marker and bigmap icon appear once unlocked.

nodes.title: Shop App
nodes.description: Unlock phone app access for team management workflows
nodes.detailedDescription:
Manage teams and racing operations from the phone.

**Effect**
- Monitor team workflow and review tasks remotely.
- Fast access to team ops controls.

nodes.title: Pit Fuel
nodes.description: Refuel fleet vehicles at the shop from the stockpile barrels
nodes.detailedDescription:
Stocked fuel barrels in the bay let you top off a team car right from the business computer — no need to drive out to a station.

**Effect**
- Adds a **Refuel** button next to Paint on the vehicle toolbar.
- Fuel is billed to the team account at the current regional average price.
- No insurance discount applies.

nodes.title: Manager
nodes.description: Auto-book sanctioned races for idle drivers (L2: pick interval + bracket match)
nodes.detailedDescription:
League 2+ — toggle on Races tab or Racing Team phone.

**L1** — Books idle drivers every **30 min** (real time).

**L2** — Interval **10–60 min**; matches fleet car to offer bracket.

**Shop App** — Lock-screen alert when a booked race is ready to spectate (not when it is booked).

trees.description: Quality-of-life: logistics and diagnostics independent of the core ops track.

nodes.title: Dyno
nodes.description: Unlock power and weight diagnostics for team prep
nodes.detailedDescription:
Add race preparation data to tune with confidence.

**Effect**
- Use live power and weight feedback when evaluating build options.

nodes.title: Garage Slots
nodes.description: +1 team vehicle slot and +1 simultaneous pull-out per level (max 2)
nodes.detailedDescription:
Expand the racing team garage workflow.

**Per level**
- +1 active team vehicle (For Sale accept / fleet roster), up to the physical garage size
- +1 vehicle you can have pulled out in the business garage at the same time

nodes.title: Towing
nodes.description: Unlock towing capability for team logistics
nodes.detailedDescription:
Bring cars to the team garage without manual handling.

**Effect**
- Retrieve off-grid vehicles directly.

nodes.title: Taxi
nodes.detailedDescription:
Unlock taxi travel to your racing team HQ.

**Requires** Dyno (same tier as Towing).

**Effect**
- **Taxi** option in the recovery menu (same section as garage taxis).
- Big map quick travel to the racing team facility (after career quick travel is unlocked).

trees.description: Roster depth and rewards from racing

nodes.title: Expanded Roster
nodes.detailedDescription:
Room for another driver on the crew.

**Per Level**
- +1 driver capacity when in League 2+
- League 1 remains focused on your solo progression

nodes.title: Reduced Cooldown
nodes.description: Shorter recovery after sanctioned proxy races
nodes.detailedDescription:
After a driver finishes a sanctioned proxy race, they need recovery time before taking another.

**Base**
- 15 minutes (career sim time)

**Per level**
- Reduces that recovery by 5% of the base (stacks with level, max 5 levels)

nodes.title: Podium Analytics
nodes.description: +10% team skill XP and driver XP from sanctioned podiums
nodes.detailedDescription:
Data off every finish line.

**Per Level**
- +10% XP granted to the team and the driver on proxy sanctioned podiums
- Stacks with sponsor XP bonuses
